python3 - <<'EOF'
def rep(p, pairs):
    s=open(p).read()
    for a,b in pairs:
        assert a in s, (p,a); s=s.replace(a,b)
    open(p,'w').write(s)
rep('README.md',[("- `extensions` accepts commas and new lines. pi-action ignores empty lines and lines that start with `#`.",
 "- `extensions` accepts commas and new lines. pi-action ignores empty lines and `#` comments: a full line, or the rest of a line after a spec and a space.")])
rep('docs/extensions.md',[
 ("Write one extension per line, or separate them with commas. pi-action ignores empty lines and lines that start with `#`. Do not put a comment after a spec on the same line: pi-action reads it as part of the spec, and the run fails.\n\nExample:",
  "Write one extension per line, or separate them with commas. pi-action ignores empty lines and `#` comments. A comment can be a full line, or it can follow a spec after a space. The `#` in a git ref such as `github:owner/repo#v1.0.0` is not a comment, because no space comes before it:"),
 ("""      # pit's typescript tool (a pi-durable extension)
      github:cv/pit#v0.35.0
      # a provider (a pi extension) from npm, pinned
      @acme/pi-provider@1.4.2
      # a provider in this repository
      ./.pi/extensions/gateway.ts""",
  """      # pi-durable extensions
      github:cv/pit#v0.35.0          # pit's typescript tool
      # pi extensions (providers)
      @acme/pi-provider@1.4.2        # from npm, pinned
      ./.pi/extensions/gateway.ts    # in this repository"""),
 ("""      # pit's typescript tool (pit/durable)
      github:cv/pit#v0.35.0""","""      github:cv/pit#v0.35.0   # pit's typescript tool (pit/durable)"""),
])
rep('docs/prompts.md',[
 ("Before pi-action finds the task, it removes HTML comments and invisible characters from the text (see [Security](security.md#what-pi-action-removes-from-text)).",
  "Before pi-action finds the task, it removes HTML comments and invisible characters from the text. It does the same to the title and the body of the issue or pull request (see [Security](security.md#what-pi-action-removes-from-text))."),
 ("| `{{title}}` | Title of the issue or pull request. `Direct prompt` for a direct prompt |","| `{{title}}` | Title of the issue or pull request, without HTML comments and invisible characters. `Direct prompt` for a direct prompt |"),
 ("| `{{body}}` | Body of the issue or pull request. Empty for a direct prompt |","| `{{body}}` | Body of the issue or pull request, without HTML comments and invisible characters. Empty for a direct prompt |"),
])
s=open('docs/security.md').read()
start=s.index('pi-action applies it to:'); end=s.index('## Extensions')
s=s[:start]+"""pi-action applies it to:

- The text that contains the trigger phrase: the comment, or the body of an issue or pull request that started pi. This gives the task and `{{trigger_comment}}`.
- The title and the body of the issue or pull request (in the built-in prompt, and in `{{title}}` and `{{body}}`), also for `pr_number` runs.
- `/answer` replies, and the titles of questions.

pi-action does **not** apply it to the diff or to review comments. The model gets this text as it is on GitHub. Also, removing hidden text does not stop prompt injection in visible text.

"""+s[end:]
open('docs/security.md','w').write(s)
EOF
